name: Clockwork Rabbit
description:
Clockwork Rabbit is a relaxing single-player isometric puzzle game set in a steampunk world inhabited by adorable bunnies.

Meet Tessa, a young mechanic working in a textile factory in Clockwork Town, where every room hides a new challenge.

The game blends time manipulation, action planning, helper robot programming, and creative puzzle solving. With no time limits, you can play at your own pace and enjoy a calm, laid-back experience.

Key features:
A calm and thoughtful puzzle experience
Single-player adventure with narrative background
Isometric perspective
Time manipulation mechanics
No violence, no ads, no microtransactions
Stylized visuals and a unique atmosphere
Suitable for both experienced and new players
Crafted with passion by an independent team

Jump into the rabbit hole with Tessa and try to catch that bunny!
